# Flizy

> Chat-native EVM wallet for WhatsApp and Telegram. Trusted sends. GIWA-first.

Flizy gives every account a permanent agent wallet. Money commands run in the chat app the
user already has, and the same account can be linked on WhatsApp and Telegram at once.
Transfers only reach destinations the user approved on the site. Swaps only go through
allowlisted DEX routers.

## Site

- / : Product home and four-step overview
- /how-it-works : Full user guide and commands for both chat apps
- /docs : Why trusted addresses exist (security)
- /signup : Create account
- /login : Sign in
- /dashboard : Wallet, PIN, trusted people, link code for WhatsApp or Telegram
- /dashboard/swap : Swap FLZ and ETH, add or remove liquidity
- /claim/:token : Claim funds waiting for non-users

## Channels

- WhatsApp: commands are prefixed, for example `flizy send 0.01 to john`, then `confirm`.
- Telegram: slash commands, for example `/send 0.01 to john`, confirm by button or by typing.
- One site link code binds either channel. Identity is proven by that code, because only a
  logged-in account holder can generate one.
- Claims are addressed to a phone number, so they can be redeemed from either channel by
  whoever owns that number. One phone belongs to exactly one account.

## When to read

- Read /how-it-works to onboard a human user on WhatsApp or Telegram.
- Read /docs when a send is rejected for destination policy.
- Read /dashboard flows for link codes and trusted address management.
